A pre-deployment or post-deployment script has a lifecycle: where it lives says what it is, it
must be safe to run twice, and it retires as a tracked act. Before adding one, check whether the
change can be purely declarative instead. See `ssdt-agent/skills/deploy-scripts/SKILL.md`.
